skill.summary: Use when user wants to generate music with Suno AI, needs help writing Suno prompts, or asks about Suno music creation. (用于用户想要使用 Suno AI 生成音乐、需要帮助编写 Suno 提示...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added detailed documentation on creating high-quality Suno AI music prompts, including explanations of style, mood, instrument, tempo, vocal, theme, mastering, and era parameters.
- Provided multiple structured prompt templates (concise, descriptive, and story/scene-based) with examples in both English and Chinese.
- Introduced comprehensive quick-reference tables for genres, moods, instruments, vocal types, mastering options, and eras (with bilingual descriptions).
- Included advanced tips for mixing styles, specifying eras, referencing artists, songwriting details, production nuances, and mastering keywords.
- Showcased common use case examples for background, game, cinematic, study, workout, sleep music, and lyric-writing.
- Expanded on mastering and era application scenarios for professional, streaming, vintage, and modern music production needs.
